newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY LARGELY SOFTER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY LARGELY SOFTER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mostly easier against hard currencies at the close of Monday's interbank trading session, foreign exchange dealers said.

"It appears people are still quoting wide...there's no liquidity in the market," one dealer said, adding that the central bank had not intervened substantially to help ease the apparent import pressure on the market.
"I think basically what they are saying is that they are happy to see the dollar go down to a certain level," he added.
The local unit finished the day at 11.7200/7400 against the U.S. dollar from Friday's 11.7100/7400 and was also softer versus sterling at 18.8700/9000 compared to 18.8500/9000.
It was at 2.5050/5350 against the South African rand from 2.5000/5100 but was quoted firmer on the mark at 6.4300/4500 compared to 6.4400/4600.
